name: intelligence-reference-set-v2-candidates
extends: v1 (reference_set_v1.json); v0 and v1 files are frozen and are not modified by this file
window: 2026-07-28..2026-11-24 (17 weeks of production intelligence_events, SELECT only, project cjvrpjwewsrumnbdydgg)
status: CANDIDATES ONLY. Nothing here is confirmed. Every record has reviewed_by_human=false. The owner or a reviewer promotes a record by copying it into a new reference set version with status confirmed_material; this file never does.
purpose: Move the reference set from 15 toward about 30 confirmed material incidents.

strict_criteria.rule: A record is proposed as a candidate only if ALL THREE hold; otherwise it is listed as unresolved (or left out).
strict_criteria.1_stated_operational_impact: The cited reporting states a concrete effect on services, customers, data or operations (an outage, services or sites offline, a named data-loss scale, calls failing, flights affected, active exploitation inside Australian organisations per a national authority). General commentary, statistics, fines, policy or opinion do not qualify.
strict_criteria.2_named_service: A specific organisation, service or product is named (a headline that only says 'a flaw' or 'a hospital' fails this test).
strict_criteria.3_credible_source: At least one primary authority (ASD/ACSC, regulator, operator status) or a national or specialist publisher (ABC, Guardian Australia, iTnews, SBS and similar). A single aggregator-only copy is not enough on its own.
strict_criteria.geography: Australian, or international with stated Australian exposure (Australian customers, travellers or organisations named in the evidence).
strict_criteria.exclusions: Anything already in reference_set_v1.json (RS-001 to RS-053) is excluded, including stale resurfacing items. Scheduled maintenance, routine status-page degradations and regulatory fines are not incidents.
strict_criteria.first_report: first_report is the earliest report TJR collected (published_at after the 2026-11-24 +10h RSS repair); an earlier public report may exist. Same convention as v1.

evidence_basis: Evidence rows are intelligence_events ids with source, published_at, collected_at and disposition as read on 2026-11-24. Headlines were read from TJR; the linked articles were NOT re-read, so scale and cause are unverified until a reviewer opens them (see uncertain_facts per record). The shortlist was found by keyword and source filters over titles, so it is a sample of what is in the table, not an exhaustive census.
known_gaps: Title keyword search cannot find incidents whose headlines avoid outage/breach/attack words.
TJR's own collection lagged or dropped items in August (see the missed-incident log), so incidents the pipeline never collected are invisible to this method.
Only 16 candidates meet all three tests; reaching about 30 confirmed material records still needs reviewer promotion plus further discovery outside TJR data.
